description: False-colour infrared satellite imagery displays a diverse riverine landscape. A wide, dark blue/black river flows diagonally from the top-right to the bottom-left, featuring a distinct, elongated island in its lower section. Inland, a meandering, narrower dark blue/black channel is visible, connecting to and surrounded by other smaller, irregularly shaped dark blue/black water bodies. The majority of the visible land area consists of agricultural fields, shown in varying shades of bright red (indicating healthy, actively vegetated areas) and lighter green/grey (suggesting bare soil, fallow land, or different crop types with less infrared reflectance). Two urban areas are prominent: a larger settlement with a dense, light blue/grey grid pattern of roads and buildings is located on the far left, and a smaller, similar urbanized area is visible towards the top-centre. The areas immediately adjacent to the main river and inland water bodies, forming riparian zones, show a mixture of red and greenish-grey tones, indicating natural vegetation and varied land cover types. The imagery highlights distinct land cover features such as large water bodies, extensive agricultural plots, and urban structures.
